objective: Report net invoiced sales by calendar month, with a monthly trend chart, supporting CSV tables and an Excel workbook. Describe coverage and data-quality limitations.
business_context: Exploratory review of the assigned historical Online Retail II source. Inspect the schema and observed date range before calculating.

metric_definitions.net_invoiced_sales: Sum Quantity multiplied by Price for rows with a valid invoice date and non-null quantity and price. Preserve negative quantities as returns or cancellations. Report currency as GBP. This is a source-row invoiced-sales measure, not cash collected or profit.
metric_definitions.population: Include source rows regardless of whether a customer identifier is present. Explain missingness and any exact duplicate rows; do not silently remove duplicates or non-product codes. Report any exclusions explicitly.

time_window: All observed invoice dates in the assigned source; identify partial boundary months.
known_limitations: Historical test data, not a current operating business.
No costs, expenses or causal conclusions are supplied by this brief.
